messages:
maria: Heads-up — planned KMS key rotation + rootfs compaction tomorrow 2026-03-21 08:00 UTC. This touches signing keys, admission enforcement, and a staged re-sign of images. Need RBAC gating, audit plan, and rollback path.

alex: Quick q — how long is the enforcement flip window? will any in-flight deploys fail?

maria: Plan is sign-and-rollforward: keep old key valid for verification for 48h after new key is live. Steps: 1) provision new key, 2) sign new images, 3) run a staged re-sign job for prod-* repos, 4) add new key to admission controller allowlist, 5) after 48h remove old key.

jin: RBAC note: cosign uses KMS Sign/GetPublicKey permissions. IAM should have a dedicated image-signer role with kms:Sign and kms:GetPublicKey scoped to the cryptoKey resource. Bind only to the k8s service account used by the signing job.

sam: Admission controller change: add feature flag so we can move from allowed_keys=[old] -> [old,new] -> [new]. Also add a grace_period_seconds: 172800 (48h) so verification allows old during transition. We'll canary in canary cluster first.

alex: Audit logging: every sign/resign event needs structured logs: image_digest, signer_principal, key_id, job_run_id, namespace. Send to audit pipeline (splunk/securelogs) with JSON fields for easy queries.

ops-bot: deploybot: starting signing job in staging in ~30m. will report results.

sec-bot: security-alert: rebase/compact can change SBOM hashes — add SBOM attestation validation step post-resign. Also run vuln scan after every batch to detect regressions.

maria: Quick sign commands for the job (reference):
```
cosign sign-blob --kms "cloudkms://projects/acme/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/new-key/cryptoKeyVersions/1" < image.tar
cosign attach attestation --predicate predicate.json --signature sig
kubectl create job sign-prod-images --from=cronjob/sign-job --namespace infra
```

jin: I'll open a terraform PR to add iam_role.image-signer and a k8s RoleBinding to serviceAccount:image-signing-job@infra. Will lock the key resource ARN in the policy.

sam: For the admission controller PR I'll add config options: enforce_signed_key_ids: [list], allowed_transition_window_seconds, and a permissive=true rollback toggle. Also rate-limit verification lookups to avoid KMS quota spikes.

alex: Rollback path: if admission controller blocks, flip to permissive mode and disable enforcement then we can revert config quickly. Also ensure we have a signed-manifest-only bypass with an incident code. Document in runbook.

maria: Who can approve prod rollout? Need approvals from @alex and @jin. I'm scheduling maintenance window 09:00-11:00 UTC prod tentatively, can we tighten to 1h?

alex: I can approve once PRs are up and e2e in staging pass. Prefer a 1h window.

jin: Scheduling maintenance now and adding runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/image-kms-rotation — includes checklist, rollback commands, and who-to-ping.

sam: Small ops detail — re-sign job should be rate-limited to avoid registry throttling. Suggest batch_size=50 and sleep_between_batches=5s, with exponential backoff on 429/5xx.

maria: noted. I'll update the job config and coordinate with registry team for burst permission.

ops-bot: deploybot: staging sign job completed: repo/prod-app@sha256:abc123 signed successfully, cosign verify OK. logs: https://ci/internal/logs/231045/signer

alex: I'll monitor audit logs during the prod rollout and check for any unusual verification failures. :eyes:

sec-bot: checklist reminder: attach SBOM attestation, push to attestation store, run vulnerability scan, and snapshot audit stream for the 48h window.

maria: thanks all — I'll post PRs and ping again when staging has a clean run.
channel_history_snippet: maria announced key rotation + compact, discussed RBAC iam role, admission controller feature toggle, audit logging fields, rate-limited re-sign job, and runbook link; ops-bot reported staging success.
